text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Decadal average: Annual rate of people requiring immediate assistance
due to all natural disasters excluding extreme temperatures

tspan.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.tspan: Rates are measured per 100,000 people. Decadal figures are measured as the annual average over the subsequent ten-year
period. Disasters include events such as earthquakes, volcanoes, droughts, wildfires, storms, and floods. Extreme
temperatures are not included here because their geographical and time coverage is poor, making consistent comparisons

tspan.tspan: EM-DAT, CRED / UCLouvain (2026); Population based on various sources (2024)
Based on recorded events; coverage is more limited before the year 2000. Longer historical trends may partly reflect reporting
